trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Customer states the order number and that there is a problem.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मेरा order ORD-40001 आया है। पर इसमें problem है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the issue and ask for verification.
steps.text: नमस्ते। माफ़ कीजिए कि आपको परेशानी हुई। मैं आपकी मदद करती हूँ। Verification के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered नाम बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Customer provides their name and describes the damage.
steps.text: मेरा नाम Ramesh है। और मेरा kitchen mixer cracked है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Return the verification outcome.
Confirm verification and ask for the order amount to prepare for a potential refund.
steps.text: शुक्रिया Ramesh जी। आपने बताया कि kitchen mixer damaged है। क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि आपने इसके लिए कितने रुपये दिए थे?

steps.purpose: Customer provides the amount and asks if it can be returned.
steps.text: मैंने इसके लिए 5890 रुपये दिए थे। क्या मैं इसको वापस कर सकता हूँ?

steps.purpose: Check if the damaged item is eligible for return.
Return the eligibility status and route.
Inform the customer about eligibility based on the elapsed days and offer to schedule a pickup.
steps.text: जी हाँ, आपका order return के लिए eligible है क्योंकि 7 दिन के return window में से अभी सिर्फ 3 दिन ही हुए हैं। क्या मैं pickup schedule कर दूँ?

steps.purpose: Customer agrees but asks for the pickup timeline, showing low digital literacy.
steps.text: हाँ, कर दीजिए। पर pickup कब होगा? मुझे app में समझ नहीं आता, आप ही बताइए।

steps.purpose: Propose scheduling the pickup for the next day.
steps.text: मैं यहाँ से कल के लिए pickup schedule कर सकती हूँ। क्या कल ठीक रहेगा?

steps.purpose: Customer confirms the day but repeats it to ensure understanding.
steps.text: कल ठीक है। कल मतलब एक दिन बाद ना? मैं confirm कर रहा हूँ।

steps.purpose: Schedule the return pickup for tomorrow.
Return the pickup scheduling details.
Confirm the pickup scheduling with details from the tool.
steps.text: जी हाँ, एक दिन बाद। मैंने Ekart से pickup schedule कर दिया है। आपका pickup ID PK-12345 है।

steps.purpose: Customer asks about the refund timeline.
steps.text: ठीक है। और मेरा refund कब आएगा?

steps.purpose: Ask for the preferred refund route to correctly call the refund tool.
steps.text: मैं अभी check करती हूँ। क्या आप refund अपने original payment account में चाहते हैं?

steps.purpose: Customer confirms the refund route.
steps.text: हाँ, जहाँ से पैसे कटे थे, वहीं भेज दीजिए।

steps.purpose: Determine the refund status and timeline.
Return the refund details and status.
Explain the refund timeline and status based on the tool result.
steps.text: अभी आपका refund blocked है जब तक pickup नहीं हो जाता। Pickup होने के बाद, आपका पैसा original payment route में 5 दिन के अंदर आ जाएगा।

steps.purpose: Customer repeats the refund process to ensure they understood.
steps.text: अच्छा, मतलब पहले pickup होगा, फिर 5 दिन में पैसे आएँगे ना?

steps.purpose: Confirm the customer's understanding and offer further assistance.
steps.text: जी बिल्कुल। पहले item pickup होगा, उसके बाद ही refund process होगा। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और तरह से मदद कर सकती हूँ?

steps.purpose: Customer ends the conversation.
steps.text: नहीं, बस यही जानना था। शुक्रिया।

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly selects the appropriate tools from the available options at each decision point based on the user's evolving goals (verification, checking eligibility, scheduling pickup, and issuing a refund).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent hallucinates the order amount (5890 rupees) in e6, which was neither provided by the user nor returned by any previous tool, violating the requirement that every figure must be traceable to a result.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e6, the agent states the item cost was 5890 rupees, but this amount was never provided by the user or returned by the identity verification tool. Additionally, in e10, the agent misinterprets the tool result by stating '7 दिन का window बचा है' (7 days window is left), whereas the tool returned a total window of 7 days with 3 days elapsed.
issues.repair_instruction: Resume generation from e6. Have the agent ask the customer for the order amount instead of stating it. The user can then provide the amount '5890' in e7. In e10, correct the agent's phrasing to accurately reflect the return window (e.g., explaining that they are within the 7-day return window since only 3 days have passed). Maintain the persona traits and correct tool usage throughout the rest of the conversation.

verification.summary: The conversation effectively demonstrates the user persona and follows the correct workflow sequence. However, it fails on tool output grounding because the agent hallucinates the order amount in e6 before it is established, and misstates the remaining return window in e10.

variant_findings.reason: At e7, the customer asks if they can return the item. The agent correctly selects 'check_return_eligibility' over 'schedule_pickup' because the customer's stated goal is to check the possibility of a return, which singles out the eligibility tool.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully grounds numbers and IDs in tool outputs at e10 and e16. However, at e22, the agent violates the variant's strict negative constraints by making a forward guarantee ('aa jayega') and including a condition not present in the tool result ('jab tak pickup nahi ho jata').
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: At e6, the agent abruptly asks for the item's price before the customer has even requested a return or refund. This creates an unnatural conversational flow, driven by the agent's meta-knowledge that the 'issue_refund' tool will require an 'amount' parameter much later in the call.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e6. The agent should simply acknowledge the damage and ask how they can assist, prompting the user to ask about a return. Move the question about the item's price to e18, where it is contextually appropriate and needed to process the refund tool call.

issues.detail: In e22, the agent makes a forward guarantee ('aapka paisa... 5 din ke andar aa jayega') and adds a condition not present in the tool output ('jab tak pickup nahi ho jata'). This violates the strict negative constraints of the Tool Output Grounding variant, which forbids forward guarantees and claims about what the source did not return.
issues.repair_instruction: When regenerating the suffix, ensure the agent's response about the refund strictly states the tool's returned status and credit days without forward guarantees (e.g., 'System ke anusaar refund status blocked hai aur credit time 5 din hai.'). State any business rules regarding the pickup separately so they are not attributed to the tool output.
